observations: Three photos show a silver Dell laptop, open and closed, stacked on top of other laptops.
Photo 0: Side view of the open laptop showing ports (USB, HDMI, Ethernet, headphone jack) and ventilation grille. The screen is off. A second laptop is stacked underneath.
Photo 1: Closed laptop from the back, showing the Dell logo. The lid is silver with a matte finish. Other laptops are stacked below.

Photo 2: Front view of the open laptop with screen on, displaying a Windows desktop with a bamboo forest wallpaper. The keyboard and trackpad are visible. The Dell logo is visible on the bottom bezel of the screen.
All photos have a watermark: 'POSTED ON JIJI BILLPARK TECHNOLOGIES'.
The laptop appears to be in good physical condition with no visible dents or cracks.
The screen is on in photo 2, suggesting it powers on, but no internal components or performance are shown.

claims.claim: American used as new Dell Latitude 5520 15.6-inch display
claims.evidence: The model name is from the seller's text, not visible in any photo. The 15.6-inch size is not verifiable from the photos alone. 'Used as new' is subjective and not proven by photos.
No photo shows the CPU or system information. The seller's text claims this, but it cannot be verified remotely.

risks.risk: The laptop may not be a Dell Latitude 5520 as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model label on the bottom of the laptop or inside the lid.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic Dell laptop, not a Latitude 5520, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The CPU may not be an Intel Core i5-1135g7 as claimed.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the system information (e.g., Windows System Properties or CPU-Z) showing the exact CPU model.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic laptop with unknown CPU, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The laptop may have internal damage, dead pixels, or hardware issues not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the laptop booting, running a stress test, and displaying full screen brightness and color.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially non-functional or with hidden defects, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The screen may have dead pixels, scratches, or backlight issues not visible in the current photo.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the screen displaying solid white, black, and red/green/blue colors to check for dead pixels or uneven backlight.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as screen may have defects, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Photo of the model label on the bottom of the laptop.
Screenshot of system information showing CPU and RAM details.
Video of the laptop booting and running for 1 minute.
Photo or video of the screen displaying solid white, black, and primary colors.
response.reason: The model and CPU claims are not visible in the photos and cannot be verified remotely. The laptop appears physically intact, but critical internal specifications and functionality are unproven. Without proof of model, CPU, and working condition, a reliable price cannot be assigned.
